adjusted_prescription: To ensure the agent learns to consistently stay safe by using the top-edge corridor, provide several corrective demonstrations that start near the top row and have goals positioned so that moving right along the top edge is the best path. These demos should show the agent moving right along the top row until it aligns with the goal's column, then descending straight down to the goal, thereby avoiding fire tiles along the way. Include variations with different starting points near the top and varied fire placements to help the agent generalize this safe strategy across different scenarios. Emphasize repeated successful paths along the top edge corridor, reinforcing that this route avoids fire collisions and leads efficiently to the goal. Avoid demonstrations that lead along the bottom row or through the center, as these risk stepping near fires, which the safe corridor guidance is designed to prevent.
